translationRepairs: Place five chambers in this hall—even Ban and Yi designing, Wang Er planning—three chambers must occupy north and south.
Place five chambers in this hall—even Ban and Chui designing, Wang Er planning—three chambers must occupy north and south.
s0168 pairs 班 with 倕; 倕 is the craftsman Chui, not Yi. The proposed idiomatic correctly replaces Yi with Chui while leaving the rest intact.
Place five chambers in this hall—even if Ban and Yi thought, Wang Er planned—they could not keep three chambers from occupying north and south.
Place five chambers in this hall—even if Ban and Chui thought, Wang Er planned—they could not keep three chambers from occupying north and south.
The literal likewise renders 倕 as Yi; the Chinese name is Chui. The proposed replacement is accurate.
Court law was then very strict; since Kua had returned without permission, he would face the charge of unauthorized departure."
Court law was then very strict; since Kua had returned without permission, he would face the charge of unauthorized departure.
Hao's speech closes at s0035 with 謝也。」; s0036 時朝法甚峻… is narrator prose with no closing quote in the Chinese, so the trailing " is spurious.
He then composed an essay On Friendship, whose wording was praised by men of the time."
He then composed an essay On Friendship, whose wording was praised by men of the time.
Kua's sigh ends at s0041; s0042 遂作朋友篇… is narration without a quotation mark in the Chinese.
He thereupon wrote an essay On Accepting Fate to explain."
He thereupon wrote an essay On Accepting Fate to explain.
The interlocutor's question ends at s0045; s0046 遂著知命論以釋之。 is narration and has no closing quote in the Chinese.
Mi was summoned as Assistant Editor on account of his noble birth but declined, transferring the post to his younger brother Yu; the edict permitted it."
Mi was summoned as Assistant Editor on account of his noble birth but declined, transferring the post to his younger brother Yu; the edict permitted it.
The fellows' saying closes in s0084; s0085 謐以公子徵拜…詔許之。 is narrative Chinese without a terminal quotation mark.
Yet the Documents "Charge to Zhong" says, "Receive Prince Zhao outside the southern gate and lead him into the Wing Chamber."
Yet the Documents "Testamentary Charge" says, "Receive Prince Zhao outside the southern gate and lead him into the Wing Chamber."
s0159 cites 尚書顧命篇; 顧命 is the Gu Ming chapter conventionally titled Testamentary Charge, not Charge to Zhong.
Yet the "Charge to Zhong" in the Documents says: "Receive Prince Zhao outside the southern gate and lead him into the Wing Chamber."
Yet the "Testamentary Charge" in the Documents says: "Receive Prince Zhao outside the southern gate and lead him into the Wing Chamber."
The literal field has the same mistranslation of 顧命 as Charge to Zhong; Testamentary Charge correctly names the Documents chapter.
Though Dong Zhongshu never glanced into his garden, Cui Yuan shut his door, Gao drifted on the river, and Zhang forgot to eat—none equals this man.
Though Dong Zhongshu never glanced into his garden, Junbo shut his door, Gao let the grain drift, and Master Zhang forgot to eat—none equals this man.
Chinese has 君伯之閉戶 and 高氏之遺漂; Cui Yuan and river-drifting are unsupported. Junbo, grain left to drift, and Master Zhang for 張生 restore the exempla.
Though Dong Zhongshu did not peep into the garden, Cui Yuan shut his door, Gao's legacy drifted away, and Master Zhang forgot food—compared with this man, they are not enough for a likeness.
Though Dong Zhongshu did not peep into the garden, Junbo shut his door, Gao's grain was left to drift, and Master Zhang forgot food—compared with this man, they are not enough for a likeness.
Literal English likewise invents Cui Yuan for 君伯 and misreads 遺漂 as legacy drifting; Junbo and grain left to drift match the Chinese.
He told court gentlemen, "Zhen Chen's conduct shames no one, but he failed the court by not recommending Li Mi."
He told court gentlemen, "Zhen Chen's conduct does not shame the age, but he failed the court by not recommending Li Mi."
行不媿時 means his conduct does not shame the age; 'shames no one' drops 時 and invents 'no one'. The proposed idiomatic matches the phrase and the unit's literal.

In youth he retired to Jigu Valley south of Qi, built cliff dwellings, lived alone in calm detachment, shunned worldly affairs, plowed and drank water, wore bark crown and grass robes, loved the classics, and devoted himself to the Way.

In youth he retired to Jigu Valley south of Qi, built cliff dwellings, lived alone in calm detachment, shunned worldly affairs, plowed and drank water, wore bark crown and grass robes, loved the classics and histories, and devoted himself to the mysterious Way.
雅好經史 requires classics and histories, and 專意玄門 is devotion to the mysterious/dark gate, not bare 'the Way'. The proposed idiomatic restores both.
